decisions.reason: A waterproof lined safety shoe range builds directly on the firm's core knowledge of leather and footwear construction, so management can read its early results and keep improving it within its established safety-shoe competence.

ESD occupational shoes are a standards-driven extension of existing safety footwear know-how, and the firm can absorb the needed sole and material expertise through supplier and testing-institute cooperation, so keeping the product is justified despite the missing website data after 2019.
A safety shoe series is the firm's core competence, which gives it high absorptive capacity to interpret market feedback and refine the line, so dropping it is unlikely.
